title: Binance VIP Program Criteria Update: Lower VIP 3 Holding Threshold and Integrate OTC Trading Volume into Spot Volume
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is committed to continuously improving the VIP Program to better recognize and reward our most valued users. Following the  March 2026 VIP program criteria adjustments , we are introducing two further updates to make VIP status more accessible and to ensure that all forms of trading activity are fairly recognised toward VIP qualification. Two Key Updates: VIP 3 Asset Holding threshold  reduced from $3,000,000 to $1,000,000 , making VIP fee rate for VIP 3 holders more competitive. OTC Spot Trading Volume now counts at 4x toward Spot Trading Volume. The OTC VIP cap is lifted to VIP 9, and the legacy OTC-only trading path is retired. 1. VIP 3 Asset Holding Threshold Reduction Effective  2026-07-21 08:00 (UTC) , the asset holding requirements for VIP 3 will be reduced from $3,000,000 to $1,000,000. This change: Makes the VIP fee rate for VIP 3 holders more competitive Enables a smoother progression for holders advancing through VIP tiers Binance Affiliate Program — Transition Arrangements To ensure a smooth transition and help protect affiliates’ existing interests, Binance will provide a  3-month grace period  following the adjustment. During this period: Affiliate commissions will continue to be calculated based on the previous VIP 3 Holder threshold. Commission distributions under this arrangement will be made at the end of the 3-month grace period. Important Notes Applicable to Affiliates Only: For the 3-month period from  2026-07-21 08:00 (UTC) to 2026-10-21 08:00 (UTC) , commission distribution will continue to follow the original VIP 3 Holder threshold prior to this adjustment, in accordance with the current rules. From  2026-10-21 08:00 (UTC)  onward, commission distribution will be calculated in accordance with the standard VIP-level rules. This transition arrangement applies only to existing referrals. Referrals invited  after 2026-07-21 08:00 (UTC)  will  not  be eligible for coverage under this arrangement. 2. OTC Spot Trading Volume Multiplier Starting  2026-07-21 08:00 (UTC) , OTC Spot Trading Volume will be calculated at a 4x multiplier and incorporated into the Spot Trading Volume metric for VIP qualification. This means that $1 in OTC Spot Trading Volume will count as $4 toward the Spot Trading Volume threshold. Example:  A user with $1,000,000 in OTC trading volume and $2,000,000 in spot trading volume would have $6,000,000 in total qualifying Spot Trading Volume ($1,000,000 * 4 + $2,000,000), meeting the VIP 2 Spot Trading Volume requirement. Additionally, OTC VIP qualification was previously capped at VIP 4. With this update, there are two key benefits: Expanding eligibility: More users who actively participate in both Spot and OTC trading will qualify for VIP status sooner. Removing the VIP 4 cap: OTC traders can now upgrade beyond VIP 4, all the way to VIP 9, matching the full range of Spot and Futures pathways. Exclusions from the OTC 4x multiplier: User is a Liquidity Provider for the OTC desk: A trade where the user acts as a Liquidity Provider does not qualify. Fiat-to-stablecoin trades: Any fiat-to-stablecoin pair, and vice versa is excluded.  Stablecoin-to-stablecoin trades: Any stablecoin-to-stablecoin pair is excluded. Updated VIP Program Criteria: To qualify for any VIP tier, users must meet the BNB Balance requirement  and  satisfy  at least one  of the following: Spot Trading Volume, Derivatives Trading Volume, Wallet Assets, or 30-Day Average Net Borrowing. Earn and BNB Holdings) 30-Day Net Borrowing (USD) VIP 1 ≥ 5 ≥ 1,000,000 ≥ 5,000,000 ≥ 100,000 ≥ 100,000 VIP 2 ≥ 25 ≥ 5,000,000 ≥ 10,000,000 ≥ 200,000 ≥ 500,000 VIP 3 ≥ 100 ≥ 20,000,000 ≥ 50,000,000 ≥ 1,000,000  ≥ 2,000,000 VIP 4 ≥ 500 ≥ 75,000,000 ≥ 600,000,000 ≥ 6,000,000 ≥ 10,000,000 VIP 5 ≥ 1,000 ≥ 150,000,000 ≥ 1,000,000,000 ≥ 50,000,000 ≥ 20,000,000 VIP 6 ≥ 1,750 ≥ 400,000,000 ≥ 2,500,000,000 ≥ 100,000,000 ≥ 40,000,000 VIP 7 ≥ 3,000 ≥ 800,000,000 ≥ 5,000,000,000 ≥ 200,000,000 ≥ 65,000,000 VIP 8 ≥ 4,500 ≥ 2,000,000,000 ≥ 12,000,000,000 ≥ 500,000,000 ≥ 120,000,000 VIP 9 ≥ 5,500 ≥ 4,000,000,000 ≥ 25,000,000,000 ≥ 1,000,000,000 ≥ 160,000,000 Notes: There are no changes to  VIP trading fees .  Spot Trading Volume includes Spot, Margin, Convert, Copy Trading, Trading Bots, Stocks, and bStocks trading volume. Wallet Assets refers to the total USD value of assets held in the user's Binance Wallet. 30-Day Average Net Borrowing refers to the daily average net borrowing volume on Binance Loans over the trailing 30-day period. Sub-account volume is combined with the master account for VIP qualification. Timeline of Key Changes: These updates will take effect on  2026-07-21 08:00 (UTC) . Users who qualify under the new criteria will be  automatically upgraded daily at 08:00 (UTC)  to the corresponding VIP tier. If a user qualifies under multiple criteria, their VIP level will reflect the highest level they meet. Users can view their latest VIP level in the  My VIP Mobile Hub .  How to Join the Binance VIP Program: There are several ways to qualify for Binance VIP, including trading, holding, and borrowing. You can achieve VIP status by meeting any of the minimum requirements shown.  Become a Binance VIP and get access to a range of VIP-only benefits, including lower fees, higher limits, priority support, advanced insights, VIP swag, event invitations and more.
